# Which detailing jobs should you take today?

> Free day planner for mobile car detailers. List the jobs with price, time on site, drive and supplies; it picks the most profitable set that fits your hours, shows take-home per hour and names jobs that need a higher price. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
